issue_context.title: `polars.Expr.str.split` could support also `Expr` instead of only `PyString`
issue_context.body:
### Description

As of now the `str.split` only supports `PyString`, but support also for `Expr` would be definitely nice to have. Below you can see the example where I found this is not supported.
https://pola-rs.github.io/polars/py-polars/html/reference/expressions/api/polars.Expr.str.split.html

```python
import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        "full_name": [
            "miroslav josef krnansky",
            "gerard mcmurray",
            "jamie simpson",
            "hans moland",
            "ricardo preve",
            "ron shelton",
            "r. curtis",
            "andy sommer",
            "juraj nvota",
            "ralf gregan",
            "dominic sena",
            "radium cheung",
            "tommy lee jones",
            "ursula meier",
            "oldrich lipsky",
            "stephen gaghan",
            "lieberich frank",
            "michael spierig",
            "steve lawson",
            "berno kurten",
            "david dobkin",
            "lucia murat",
            "jairus cobb",
            "marc forster",
            "petr horky",
            "jankovics madarasz zoltan",
            "s. skoda",
            "edward ornelas",
            "michael vejar jr.",
            "larry bishop",
            "robert fedor",
            "jason wan",
            "dean white",
            "sebastian schipper",
        ]
    }
)

df.with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col("full_name").str.contains(" "))
    .then(pl.col("full_name").str.split(" ").list.last())
    .otherwise(pl.col("full_name"))
    .alias("surname")
).with_columns(
    pl.col("full_name").str.split(pl.col("surname")).list.first().alias("names")
)
```
gives me
```
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TypeError                                 Traceback (most recent call last)
Cell In [8], line 50
      1 import polars as pl
      3 df = pl.DataFrame(
      4     {
      5         "full_name": [
   (...)
     41     }
     42 )
     44 df.with_columns(
     45     pl.when(pl.col("full_name").str.contains(" "))
     46     .then(pl.col("full_name").str.split(" ").list.last())
     47     .otherwise(pl.col("full_name"))
     48     .alias("surname")
     49 ).with_columns(
---> 50     pl.col("full_name").str.split(pl.col("surname")).list.first().alias("split")
     51 )

File /home/default/lib/python3.10/site-packages/polars/expr/string.py:1431, in ExprStringNameSpace.split(self, by, inclusive)
   1429 if inclusive:
   1430     return wrap_expr(self._pyexpr.str_split_inclusive(by))
-> 1431 return wrap_expr(self._pyexpr.str_split(by))

TypeError: argument 'by': 'Expr' object cannot be converted to 'PyString'
```

The fix for me was to construct a regex to get rid of the last word. However you can imagine more general example where defining such regex would be difficult. 
```python
df.with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col("full_name").str.contains(" "))
    .then(pl.col("full_name").str.split(" ").list.last())
    .otherwise(pl.col("full_name")),
    pl.col("full_name").str.replace(r'\s\S+$', '').alias("names")
)
```

Tested with `polars==0.19.2`.
